body:
Card counters now use compact rows with 14-day saved-total charts, expandable full history, horizontal gestures and tap-to-type numeric entry. Save/Cancel appear during editing; the redundant date/timezone line is removed. Existing confirmation, conflict recovery, configuration and hidden-counter controls remain. Incomplete drafts survive reordering, autosave, session loss and midnight; a focus-scroll regression is fixed.

Verification: full gate passes 251 Rust, 133 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; eight release Chromium and five WebKit suites pass. Reviewed 320–1440px, tablet and landscape, light/dark, history and maximum numeric entry. Rebuilt/restarted the existing manual application: trusted HTTPS at https://100.122.250.14:47832 serves all 33 matching build assets; all 33 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-compact-card-counters.md. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Compact card counters with gestures and daily trends
